title: Shout It
story: The market crier announces each word in capitals, along with how long it is.
goal: Read a word. Print it in capitals, a space, then its length (like ALICE 5).
starter:
word = input()
# print the word in capitals and its length
hints: Strings have built-in tools called methods. word.upper() gives the capital version.
len(word) counts the characters. print() can show two things separated by a space.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Shout It”?
